seal.description: This Sphere takes sealed messages and cards with a seal key (spec/protocol.md section 9.1). A Sphere that predates sealing leaves it out, and refuses both.

features.description: The additions to obi/0.1 this Obysphere takes, sorted (spec/README.md, 'Versions'). A client ignores an id it doesn't know. An Obysphere that predates features leaves it out.
